name: BLESPlo.it Light
description: Example lightbulb: on/off (notify), RGB color, optional secret-challenge, and optional disconnect if no on/off switch write in time.
author: Slawomir Jasek
notes: vars.device_name is the GAP Device Name and the advertised Complete Local Name (default BLESPlo.it light, 1–29 bytes). A write to Device Name (2A00) updates it and persists with vars_save. Set vars.disconnect_without_switch to true to drop the central if no on/off (CHR_ONOFF) write arrives within vars.disconnect_without_switch_seconds (default 3) of connect.
